_meta.method: CDP getComputedStyle + CSS rules from live pages; palette/spacing/typography cross-checked with open source SCSS github.com/nationalarchives/tna-frontend (v1.6.3, MIT) src/nationalarchives/variables/*.scss
_meta.note: Computed values in raw/ were partly taken with Chrome prefers-color-scheme=dark (site default theme is 'system'); light values below come from the SCSS palette and light-mode screenshots.

stack.www: Wagtail/Django CMS (repo nationalarchives/ds-wagtail) + TNA Frontend, static/main.css?v=26.11.06.2040, main.min.js, no JS framework (data-module attributes)
stack.new_catalogue: beta.nationalarchives.gov.uk/catalogue (codename 'etna', classes etna-accordion + tna-*), tag 'Beta' phase banner
stack.discovery: legacy ASP.NET site: jQuery 3.4.1, jQuery UI autocomplete CSS, hopscotch tour, React components from cdn.nationalarchives.gov.uk/react-components/dist/discovery-1.2.9.js, main.min.2021.css, Roboto Mono + Open Sans + Bitter via Google Fonts

heading.loaded_from: Adobe Typekit https://use.typekit.net/kaq6qqh.css (commercial licence; woff2 served from use.typekit.net/af/...)

detail_mono.use: chips/tags, supertitles, hero subtitle ('Explore 1,000 years of history'), catalogue reference code, date search; Discovery uses it for h1/h2

colour.green_accent_pages: html.tna-template--green-accent: hero band background #00623b is used for chips; page hero uses pastel-green #dde5d5 (seen on home screenshot); explore story chips forest #00623b with white mono text
colour.theme_switch: footer: 'Change the site theme' System / Light / Dark (classes tna-template--system-theme|light|dark), html color-scheme 'light only' toggled; also @media (prefers-contrast: more)

discovery_old.cookie_banner: navy-blue band (colour by eye, not measured)
discovery_old.filter_heading_bg: dark grey band (by eye) with white mono text (see disc-search-desktop-fold.png)

shape.radius: 2px (rounded-border-radius), and 0.1px on most boxes (hack: keeps border-radius computed but visually square)
shape.button_border: 4px solid (same colour as bg) -> becomes the focus/hover ring
shape.shadows: none anywhere (0 box-shadow on 2500 sampled nodes) - hierarchy made only by flat colour bands and borders
shape.link_underline: text-decoration underline, thickness 1.5px (4.5px on big card headings), offset 0.125em (=2.375px at 19px)

global_header.structure: phase banner 44 + utility row (Search, Shop; icon + 16px label) + logo 96x96 (square wordmark 3-row box) left + 2-col nav list right (6 links, each with 1px keyline bottom, 36px row)
global_header.mobile: phase banner stacks (~100px), then header band ~88px: logo 56px + 'Menu' bold + 3-bar icon; nav behind Menu button (opened state not captured)
global_header.bg: computed rgb(1,1,1) #010101, visually fades to #1e1e1e under phase banner; white text

hero_home.subtitle: Roboto Mono (size not measured, ~22px by eye)
hero_home.buttons: 3 black buttons 48px high, label bold 18 + chevron icon

search_field.button: 48x48 black square with magnifier icon, 4px border
search_field.autocomplete: none seen on www/new catalogue; Discovery old UI has jQuery UI autocomplete CSS

card.variant_featured: image left 400px (square-edge) + dark #101112/#1e1e1e panel; mono chip 'EXHIBITION' on forest green; heading link 36px supria underlined 4.5px with chevron icon; image corner radius 2px
card.variant_grid: 3 columns, image on top, no shadow
card.full_click: tna-card--full-click: whole card clickable via heading link ::after

components.secondary_navigation: tabs under breadcrumbs ('About this record' active with 5px forest underline | 'What is this page?')

footer.bg: dark band (dark theme #101112 measured; light theme value not measured)
footer.blocks: address Kew TW9 4DU, social icons, Quick links, Other websites (links incl. 'National Archives Design System'), newsletter subscribe, legal links, OGL v3.0 statement

components.tabs_catalogue: Records at the National Archives (24,383) | Records at other UK archives (2,199) - active tab = underline 5px forest, inactive = blue link
components.result_card_new_catalogue: bordered 1px card: chip (PIECE/ITEM/SERIES) + title link with chevron + highlighted match (yellow #fc0 mark) + definition rows Held by / Date / Reference (label col muted ~25%, value col)
components.sort_and_view: Sort by select 206x38 (2px border) + icon buttons list/grid 48x...; 'Showing results 1-20 of 24,383'
components.accordion_record_details: etna-accordion: 'Full description and record details' with toggle 'Hide field descriptions' - each field shows its own help text in parentheses under the label
components.hierarchy_discovery: #hierarchy nav 'You are in' + list of ancestor links (Department -> Division -> Series -> Subseries -> This record) + 'browse from here by hierarchy | by reference'; new catalogue: 'Catalogue hierarchy' block with counts ('Over 27 million records')

transitions: nothing else on www: no hover transforms, no parallax
animations: image-loader-background 1.2s ease-in-out infinite (grey pulsing placeholder behind lazy images = skeleton for images)
motion.focus: thick offset outline + box-shadow ring (a11y.focus-outline-*), yellow #fc0 used for focus/highlight

viewer.iiif_viewer: NOT FOUND: item E 31/2/2/3498 (new catalogue) says 'available online and can be downloaded. How to view it' - digital copy is a download, no OpenSeadragon/Mirador/UV in DOM or network on catalogue pages
viewer.story_page: image gallery 'Image 1 of 3' on dark #1e1e1e band with large static document photo, pager under it (tna-gallery component)
